page: Microsoft Azure E64ds_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance based on the x86_64 architecture, operating under Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization. The hardware configuration features an Intel Xeon Platinum 8272CL processor running at a base frequency of 2.6 GHz. It provides 64 dedicated virtual CPUs derived from 32 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. Cache provisions include 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and a shared 48 MB L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX-512 (Foundation and VNNI), AES, and BMI2.

The system is provisioned with 504.0 GB of system memory, yielding an allocation of 7.88 GB per vCPU, aligning with an approximate 1:8 core-to-memory ratio characteristic of memory-optimized hardware. Storage includes 2577 GB of bundled local SSD storage, and the instance supports Premium Storage. The machine does not feature a dedicated GPU accelerator, relying entirely on CPU-based execution for all tasks.

Benchmark evaluations reveal top-tier results in uncached large-block memory bandwidth, registering 216.19 GB/sec read and 96.58 GB/sec write throughput. The PassMark memory test and database operations tests both score in the upper quartile, alongside multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 248.82 GB/sec. General multi-core and single-core computational benchmarks, such as Geekbench, stress-ng, and PassMark overall scores, sit within the median performance bracket.

Workload tradeoffs reflect the absence of GPU acceleration and modest per-core throughput. While small-model LLM prompt processing achieves strong scores, generation on larger models such as 70B parameter networks falls into the bottom quartile at 2.74 tokens per second. Consequently, this server instance is best deployed for large-scale in-memory databases, relational database engines, high-throughput analytics pipelines, and caching layers that leverage the 504.0 GB memory footprint and integrated local SSD capacity.
description: Microsoft Azure E64ds_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine featuring 64 dedicated vCPUs (32 physical cores) powered by an Intel Xeon Platinum 8272CL processor at 2.6 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system provides 504.0 GB of RAM alongside 2577 GB of bundled local SSD storage, with no integrated GPU. Benchmark metrics highlight strong memory subsystem throughput, with uncached read bandwidth reaching 216.19 GB/sec, write bandwidth reaching 96.58 GB/sec, and high-tier scores in database operations and multi-threaded decompression. General compute and web serving throughput maintain mid-tier levels, while large-scale LLM text generation shows lower throughput due to CPU-only execution. The resource profile aligns best with in-memory databases, large data caches, and memory-intensive relational database engines.
